title: s2_5_authorization_replay_ledger_v1
description: Hash-chained authorization replay-ledger contract for S2.5 (design §5.6/§5.7; mirrors the sibling s2_4_authorization_replay_ledger_v1). Each S2.5A/S2.5B apply durably consumes its operator-permit authorization_id here before any lifecycle effect; the ledger is append-only, persisted under the S2.5 state root with the journal durability discipline (unique O_NOFOLLOW|O_EXCL temp name, file fsync, atomic replace, parent-dir fsync, mode 0600) and its head (entry count + tail entry_digest) is pinned by the start journal so a truncated, wiped, forked or reordered ledger is rejected (AUTHORIZATION_REJECTED). entries are ordered and hash-chained: the genesis entry's prev_entry_digest is null and every later entry binds the previous entry_digest; seq must equal the entry index. A consumed authorization is never released by rollback. self_digest is integrity evidence only.
